title: Developing Purchasing Policies & Processes
overview: Purchasing policies, processes, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are crucial in guiding the work of purchasing professionals and their internal stakeholders. These documents provide both operational and ethical direction. To be effective, they must align with the organization’s strategic objectives and broader environment while being written in a clear, appropriate style. This course will teach participants how to develop purchasing policies, process flowcharts, and SLAs in a precise and straightforward manner to meet modern organizational standards. Additionally, participants will learn how to measure and analyze performance for continuous improvement.
audience: This course is ideal for purchasing and supply chain management professionals at all levels, as well as other personnel involved in the procurement process.
methodology: The course employs a workshop-based approach with interactive activities focused on planning and drafting policies. It also includes designing, mapping, and evaluating processes, as well as drafting effective SLAs.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the strategic importance of purchasing within the organization
Apply modern business writing techniques to create policies, processes, procedures, and SLAs
Formulate purchasing policies that effectively guide procurement activities
Design cross-functional processes that optimize efficiency, cost, time, and output
Develop SLAs that establish clear and effective engagement rules between the purchasing department and other organizational functions
